note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

The commandments read OWB's Exodus 20 everywhere they are quoted, whole or in part (Deuteronomy 5 only where Watson cites it): ከእኔ ጎን ሌሎች አማልክት አይኑሩህ; ለራስህ የተቀረጸ ጣዖት አትሥራ …; የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ለሐሰት ወይም ለከንቱ ነገር አትጠቀምበት; የሰንበትን ቀን አስታውስ፤ ቅዱስ አድርገህም ለይተው; አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር; አትግደል; አታመንዝር; አትስረቅ; በባልንጀራህ ላይ የሐሰት ምስክርነት አትስጥ; የባልንጀራህን ቤተሰብ አትመኝ …. The preface is OWB 20:1-2 (ባሪያ ሆነህ ከኖርክበት ቤት, with one bridge to Watson's prose term የባርነት ቤት, which stays).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the clause Watson quotes, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. OWB's inner quotation marks become ‹› inside the book's «», and a closing » that ends a speech is dropped. Where Watson's next words lean on a quoted word, the prose follows OWB, with a one-time bridging gloss where his argument turns on the old word (Ex 20:5 'visiting' → «…አመጣለሁ»; 'mercy unto thousands' → OWB ጽኑ ፍቅር; 'in vain' keeps ከንቱ, OWB's own word; 1 Cor 10:16 'communion'; Matt 12:20; Job 1:8; Phil 3:15). Watson's running prose terms (የባርነት ቤት, ቀናተኛ አምላክ, ምሕረት, the Supper's እንጀራ) stay.

Citations changed where the quoted words belong to another verse (the Acts 9:6 → 22:10 rule): Acts 9:6 → ሐዋ 22፥10; '1 Chron 22:5' → 2ዜና 34፥27; 1 Tim 1:17 'the only wise God' → ሮሜ 16፥27; John 10:17 → 10፥15; Lev 25:25 → 25፥17.

`self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and paraphrases in Watson's own sentences, his imagined speeches, quotations of the Fathers and other writers, critical-text cases rendered from the English (Matt 23:14, 1 John 5:7, Mark 9:24, Gal 5:21, Rev 22:14, Col 4:15), and quotations kept in the translator's wording because OWB lacks or reverses the word Watson argues from (listed for the founder in the PR).
